newsitem.title: USA: LPC--Wells Fargo backs Walls LBO with loan.
newsitem.headline: LPC--Wells Fargo backs Walls LBO with loan.

text.p: NEW YORK, April 23 (LPC) - Wells Fargo & Co has brought to the syndicated loan market a $145 million loan backing Haas Wheat & Partners' roughly $150 million leveraged buyout of Walls Industries from Butler Capital, market sources said.

The loan is structured as a $75 million, five-year revolving credit; a $23 million, six-year A-term loan; a $20 million, eight-year B-term loan; and a $27 million, nine-year C-term loan, sources said.
B- and C-term loans, which will be sold to institutional investors, such as prime rate funds and insurance companies, have longer tenors and richer pricing than revolvers and traditional term loans.
Wells Fargo also is providing $35 million in subordinated debt, according to bankers.
Walls Industries manufactures, designs and markets clothing for the work wear and outer-wear markets.
